description: Four standalone CLI commands exit 0 while doing less with no error-level signal (COMP-HOST-PORTABILITY-1 host C SD01-04): roadmap prints nothing for a populated roadmap; experiment reports complete with nCompleted 0/1; remote status omits server health when COMPOSE_API_TOKEN is unset; migrate-anon --non-interactive changes nothing and returns 0. Each must render its result or report the incomplete state distinctly (message + exit code). Gap G7.

completions.notes: Gap G7 from COMP-HOST-PORTABILITY-1, rows SD01-SD04. All four reproduced. roadmap returned silently when zero named rows parsed; experiment ignored incomplete run records; remote status skipped the paired-device query without a token; migrate-anon discarded its listed/promoted result. Each now names what it did not do on stderr and exits 1; --dry-run stays exit 0 because a no-op the caller asked for is not a failure. Controller verified the new remote-status throw does not swallow prior output (the caller streams each line via console.log as it is pushed, and its catch prints the message and exits 1). Verified with COMPOSE_PORT=19997: cli-honest-exit 8/8, roadmap-plan-golden 4/4; full suite 7236/7238 (one load-only flake, one pre-existing red owned by another session).
